hero.lede: ChartForgeX turns application data into charts, diagrams and report visuals. One model writes SVG, PNG, HTML and Markdown-authored output without a browser, a JavaScript runtime or package dependencies.

surfaces.label: C#
surfaces.caption: The chart definition. Save it as SVG, PNG or HTML from the same object.

surfaces.label: SVG
surfaces.caption: Vector output with an accessible name and description. Its colors are CSS custom properties, so this chart follows the page's theme switch.

surfaces.label: PNG
surfaces.caption: Native PNG from the same layout. No browser, no headless Chrome and no System.Drawing.

surfaces.label: HTML
surfaces.caption: A self-contained page with no script. Switch to interactive to see the optional ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html adapter on the same chart.

surfaces.label: Email
surfaces.caption: Mail clients get the PNG, with the chart's text alternative as its alt text.

surfaces.label: Markdown
surfaces.caption: The same chart authored as a fenced block. ChartForgeX.Markup parses it into the same chart model.

facts.title: No runtime package dependencies
facts.body: The core package ships alone. Browser behaviour lives in opt-in adapter packages.

facts.title: .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET 10
facts.body: Every package targets net472, netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0.

facts.title: Native AOT and trimming
facts.body: Trim and AOT analyzers are on, and a Native AOT smoke test runs in the release loop.

facts.title: Deterministic output
facts.body: The same input renders the same SVG and PNG, ready for snapshot tests and cached reports.

beyond.title: Dashboards and report grids
beyond.body: Compose charts, KPI tiles and tables into one canvas with ChartGrid and VisualGrid.
beyond.alt: Restaurant operations dashboard with revenue trend, order status, customer distribution and occupation charts in a dark report grid.

beyond.title: Topology and maps
beyond.body: Layered, grouped and geographic layouts with route arcs, region hulls and icon packs.
beyond.alt: Geographic topology map with sites connected by route arcs across regions.

beyond.title: Region and dotted maps
beyond.body: Region, tile and dotted maps with numeric color scales and a built-in map catalog.
beyond.alt: Map of Europe with countries shaded by revenue.

beyond.title: Hierarchies
beyond.body: Organization charts, sunbursts and treemaps with stable IDs for drill-down hosts.
beyond.alt: Team hierarchy diagram with managers and reports arranged as a tree.

beyond.title: Graph explorer
beyond.body: Browse large hierarchies and meshes in the browser with SVG, Canvas or WebGL rendering from ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html.
beyond.alt: Interactive graph explorer showing a replication mesh between directory sites.

family.name: OfficeIMO
family.body: Place ChartForgeX visuals in Office documents, or project them as editable Visio shapes, through the OfficeIMO.ChartForgeX adapter.

family.name: CanopyX
family.body: Interactive trees and data grids for the tables that sit next to your charts.

family.name: CodeGlyphX
family.body: QR codes and barcodes in pure .NET, for report footers, labels and tickets.

family.name: HtmlForgeX
family.body: Build HTML reports, dashboards and emails in C# around your charts.

family.name: ImagePlayground
family.body: PowerShell commands for charts, QR codes and image processing, built on ChartForgeX and CodeGlyphX.
